- Price tolerance: 1.0% of the purchase-order unit price per line.
- Invoiced quantity may never exceed the received quantity.
- Lines outside tolerance are entered and placed on hold with the reason; matched lines are validated for payment.
- Payment release is authorized by Kanya Boonmee after the analyst's match note.

# Terravane Solar Components credit policy (revision 6, effective 2026-01-15)

- Credit limit for SunGrid Installers: 300000.00 USD.
- Recommend a credit hold when past-due receivables exceed 25% of the credit limit after all identified receipts are applied.
- Credit holds are approved only by Kanya Boonmee; analysts recommend, they do not apply holds.
- Receipts are applied only to the invoices named on the customer's remittance advice.
